name: Champion
description:
You have trained as a champion for the public bouts of Adiri's stages and arenas.

Any time you enter engagement with a foe and there are no other adjacent combatants, you may re-roll one of your engagement dice before resolving. If there are no other combatants within short range, you may re-roll each of your engagement dice before resolving.

Describe how you fight best one-on-one.
